content.comment_body: Hello, I recently installed [product_name] [version_no] on my computer, but when I attempt to launch it, I receive the message: Java Platform SE Binary has stopped working. I have tried reinstalling both [product_name] and Java, as well as uninstalling everything, clearing the registry, and attempting again, but nothing has worked so far. My computer is running Windows Vista 32-bit. Does anyone have any suggestions?
Hi [user_name], Did you use this installation procedure? [url]
Hello, Are you able to launch [product_name] [version_no] directly from the CD?

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a critical startup issue with [product_name] [version_no], specifically a Java error immediately upon launching after installation. Standard troubleshooting steps—such as reinstalling both the software and Java, uninstalling, and clearing the registry—did not resolve the problem. This ongoing problem points to reliability concerns due to [product_name]'s dependency on Java when used with Windows Vista 32-bit.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to install and operate smoothly on Windows Vista 32-bit, without experiencing Java-related crashes.
